description: The full content of one OnMap.me page as markdown (hours, address, phone, prices, questions and answers, guides), with where the facts come from. For an unofficial page it also gives the place's official site, the day the facts were last checked there, and the source pages.

handle.description: The page's handle, for example "klyde-warren-park" (the part after onmap.me/@).

name: get_page
title: Read a page
